kind: single-case integration smoke, not an independent LLM benchmark
proposal_author: current assistant session; source and prior diagnostic already visible
plan: one uniform Grover iteration proposes a witness; classical prefix repair preserves firstness; absent/invalid sample falls back
iteration_policy: one fixed iteration, not selected by knowing the answer count
negative_control: direct return of any satisfying witness; deliberately wrong engineering control, not an observed LLM failure
scope: run one instance through source binding, concrete circuit, ideal semantic checks, real QDK estimate, host timing, full cost ledger and decision
hardware_profiles: two explicitly hypothetical gate-based profiles; not user's calibrated QPU
timing: 7 batches of 1000 source wrapper calls; min/max batch means are descriptive, not confidence bounds
outputs: new run directory only; include hashes, raw QDK results, stage feedback, report
